tasks.title: Create the project, budget, Pulumi stack and DNS delegation
tasks.implementation: Create the GCP project and billing account with a $150 monthly budget alert, enable the APIs, create the Pulumi Cloud project and stack, create the Cloud DNS zone for clientbridge.ca with the staging records under it, and delegate the registrar's nameservers to it.
tasks.acceptance: pulumi preview runs; dig shows the Cloud DNS nameservers for clientbridge.ca.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Build the backend and web images
tasks.implementation: Write staged Dockerfiles (base, dev, prod) for the backend (API, worker and migrate entry points, sync-rules.yaml included, non-root user) and the web image (web, Connect and site builds served by Caddy with frontend/Caddyfile); add an app profile to docker-compose.yml that runs both prod images against the local services; CI builds both images on every push and runs the web, Connect and sync e2e jobs against them.
tasks.acceptance: docker compose --profile app up serves every host locally from the prod images; CI's e2e jobs pass against the images it built; the backend image starts the API, the worker and the migrate step by command.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Derive every URL from one base domain
tasks.implementation: Add BASE_DOMAIN and derive WEB_BASE_URL, CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS, the Connect, Pay and Shop hosts, the auth service and PowerSync URLs, the OAuth callback and the RP ID; serve a runtime config.js from the web image; pass the slug host into the catalog message; robots.txt allows indexing only in production; extend the production startup check to every required setting and to agreement with BASE_DOMAIN.
tasks.acceptance: Booting with only BASE_DOMAIN and secrets yields the full set of URLs for both environments; a mismatched URL or missing setting refuses to start; tests cover both environments.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Readiness, logging and the client address
tasks.implementation: Add a readiness endpoint that checks the database and Redis, a JSON logging config for the API and worker, the worker pinned to UTC, and a trusted-hop setting for X-Forwarded-For used by the rate limiter and the contract signer IP.
tasks.acceptance: Readiness fails when the database or Redis is down; a spoofed X-Forwarded-For does not change the limiter key or signer IP; logs are one JSON object per line.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Production auth service and PowerSync configs
tasks.implementation: Set the auth service's production values through environment variables over infra/auth/kratos.yml (no --dev, public URL at api.D/auth with the Gateway stripping the prefix, a __Host- session cookie with path /, RP ID app.D, courier over the cluster network, Google OIDC callback) and PowerSync's over infra/powersync/powersync.yaml (RS256, jwks_uri to /sync/keys, Postgres bucket storage); verify web and mobile sign-in, recovery, Google sign-in and passkeys against the new cookie.
tasks.acceptance: A local stack with production-shaped configs passes the auth e2e on web and mobile and the sync e2e.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Network, cluster and identity in Pulumi
tasks.implementation: Pulumi creates the VPC with private service access and Cloud NAT, the regional Autopilot cluster (regular channel, private nodes, DNS control plane endpoint, Workload Identity, Managed Prometheus off), the prod and staging namespaces with their service accounts and NetworkPolicies, Artifact Registry with a cleanup policy keeping 10 digests, and the GitHub OIDC pool restricted to this repository.
tasks.acceptance: pulumi up from an empty project creates everything; a second run shows no changes; CI can push an image and reach the cluster without a stored key.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Database, buckets and secrets in Pulumi
tasks.implementation: Pulumi creates the db-g1-small Cloud SQL instance (zonal, private IP, TLS, backups 7 days, PITR, logical decoding) with the six databases, one versioned private bucket per environment with HMAC keys, and the Secret Manager secrets with the GKE Secret Manager add-on; db_access.py is made to work with Cloud SQL's non-superuser postgres and the publication is created as the migrator.
tasks.acceptance: db_access roles and grants and alembic upgrade head succeed on the new instance; the powersync publication lists only synced tables; protect is set on the instance, the cluster and the zone.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Workloads, Gateway and certificates
tasks.implementation: In infra/pulumi/kubernetes, one module per workload (namespace, settings, sidecar, api, worker, migrate, auth, powersync, web, redis, gateway) deploys the plan's table into both namespaces: requests, Spot for the worker and all of staging, Auth Proxy sidecars, surge-one rolling updates, the migrate Job, the auth service and PowerSync mounting infra/auth and infra/powersync as ConfigMaps, and upstream image digests read from docker-compose.yml. gateway.py adds one Gateway on a static IP with an HTTPRoute per host, Certificate Manager wildcard and apex certificates by DNS authorization, the HTTP to HTTPS redirect, raw passthrough for /webhooks/* and a one-hour backend timeout for sync.
tasks.acceptance: Every host in both environments answers over HTTPS; a deploy of a new digest has no failed requests; a webhook signature verifies through the Gateway.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Deploy pipeline
tasks.implementation: A workflow pushes images by digest and runs pulumi up for staging on every push to main (migrate Job first, stop on failure, wait for rollout, smoke test api., sync. and app.), and for production with the same digests behind a manual approval; rollback redeploys the previous digests.
tasks.acceptance: A push to main reaches staging without manual steps; a failing migration leaves the old version running; a rollback restores the previous digests.
tasks.execution_rule: Start only on the user's go; no commits, pushes or schema changes without approval; production resources only after staging passes.

tasks.title: Providers in test mode and mobile builds

tasks.acceptance: Every provider's webhook reaches staging and verifies; a test payment, SMS and email go through end to end; a staging build on iPhone and Android signs in, syncs and receives a push.

tasks.title: Logs, alerts and budget

tasks.acceptance: Stopping staging's PowerSync raises the slot lag alert; scaling the API to zero raises the uptime alert; Error Reporting shows a forced exception.

tasks.title: Restore drill

tasks.acceptance: Staging is restored to a chosen minute from the runbook alone, PowerSync re-snapshots, and clients resync.
